title: clarkia speciosa subsp. nitens
intro: Clarkia speciosa subsp. nitens, commonly known as the bright star or shining star, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the evening primrose family (Onagraceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its ability to reduce inflammation and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its sedative and anti-anxiety properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of insomnia and anxiety disorders. The bioactive constituents of Clarkia speciosa subsp. nitens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
